rendered.title: Competitive Programming Platform — Practice & Compete | AlgoWars
rendered.text: ← Back to home COMPETITIVE PROGRAMMING AlgoWars takes competitive programming to the next level with real-time head-to-head battles. No more solving problems in isolation — prove your skill against real opponents. What Makes AlgoWars Different Unlike traditional online judges where you practice alone, AlgoWars pairs you with an opponent of similar skill in real-time. Both of you receive the same problem and race to solve it first. This creates genuine competitive pressure that accelerates learning. Problem Library Access over 1,800 algorithmic problems across difficulty levels from 800 to 1600+. Problems cover arrays, strings, graphs, dynamic programming, number theory, and more. New problems are added regularly from competitive programming sources. Rating System AlgoWars uses an Elo-based rating system (similar to chess) that ensures fair matchmaking. You start at 1000 and climb through victories. The global leaderboard shows where you stand among all competitors. Supported Languages Compete in C++17, C++20, Python 3, PyPy3, or Java 17. Choose the language that gives you the competitive edge. JOIN ALGOWARS → VIEW LEADERBOARD
